data.action: 仰卧榻榻米双腿轻微分开自抚，渐变发丝散落，紫瞳含泪不再伪装微笑
data.camera: vertical POV, supine, touching own body, futon bedding, lantern glow, emotional tears
data.description: 【蝶屋敷寝室·深夜】永远微笑的虫柱，在床上第一次收起了笑容。忍仰卧在大床上，黑紫渐变发丝散开，紫瞳湿润地仰视着你。没有了平日公式化的假笑，泪从眼角滑落，喉咙里溢出最真实的声音——「哈啊……呐、你知道吗……只有在你面前……我才、才不用一直笑……」
data.lighting: 纸灯笼暖光在肌肤上流淌
data.promptProse: The always-smiling Insect Hashira puts her smile away for the first time in the quiet of the night. Lying across the Butterfly Mansion's soft futon with her wavy gradient black-purple hair flowing unbound across the tatami, Kochou Shinobu looks up through glistening violet eyes. Her petite chest rises and falls with tender, unadorned sighs as one trembling hand explores the warmth between her parted thighs. Tears slip silently past her flushed cheeks as she confesses in a fragile whisper that only before you does she never have to keep smiling. Vulnerable vertical composition, warm lantern glow over pale skin, detailed Japanese room background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 蝶屋寝室的真话夜·「只有在你面前……才不用笑」
